Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f java.tar.gz ]] && rm -f java.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO java.tar.gz https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/ga/linux/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse || { echo \"Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'languagetool'; if (Test-Path 'java/bin/java.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& java/bin/java.exe --version | Select-String -Pattern 'Temurin-(\d+(?:\.\d+\.\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?\+\d+)' | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value }) } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; $LatestVersionBuild = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri \"https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&os=windows&vendor=eclipse\")[0].version.openjdk_version -replace '-LTS$', ''; if ( $InstalledVersion -eq $LatestVersionBuild ) { Write-Output \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path java.zip ) { Remove-Item java.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}/ga/windows/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse -OutFile java.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Expand-Archive -Path \"java.zip\" -DestinationPath \".\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path java.zip ) { Remove-Item java.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; if (Test-Path \"jdk-*\") { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-ChildItem -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like \"jdk-*\" } | Rename-Item -NewName \"java\" *> $null; Write-Output \"Eclipse Temurin Java $LatestVersionBuild downloaded\" } }"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location 'languagetool'; $v = '{{ServerVersion}}'.Trim(); if ($v -and ($v -notmatch '^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?[a-z]?$')) { Write-Output ('Invalid LanguageTool version format specified: ' + $v); exit 1 }; if ($v) { $f = 'LanguageTool-' + $v + '.zip' } else { $f = 'LanguageTool-stable.zip' }; $u = 'https://languagetool.org/download/' + $f; try { $h = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method Head -Uri $u } catch { Write-Output ('Could not find ' + $u + '. Check the LanguageTool Version setting. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $m = $f + ' ' + $h.Headers['Last-Modified'] + ' ' + $h.Headers['Content-Length']; if ((Test-Path 'server/languagetool-server.jar') -and (Test-Path 'server/.installed-version') -and ((Get-Content 'server/.installed-version' -Raw).Trim() -eq $m)) { Write-Output ($f + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; Remove-Item 'languagetool.zip', 'extract' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('Downloading ' + $u); try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $u -OutFile 'languagetool.zip' } catch { Remove-Item 'languagetool.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Download failed from languagetool.org. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::ExtractToDirectory((Join-Path (Get-Location) 'languagetool.zip'), (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'extract')); $d = Get-ChildItem 'extract' -Directory | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $d -or -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $d.FullName 'languagetool-server.jar'))) { Write-Output 'The downloaded archive does not contain languagetool-server.jar. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path 'server') { Remove-Item 'server' -Recurse -Force }; Move-Item -Path $d.FullName -Destination 'server'; Remove-Item 'extract', 'languagetool.zip' -Recurse -Force; Set-Content -Path 'server/.installed-version' -Value $m; Write-Output ($d.Name + ' installed')"

-c "Version=$(echo '{{ServerVersion}}' | tr -d '[:space:]'); cd languagetool || exit 1; if [[ -n \"$Version\" && ! \"$Version\" =~ ^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?[a-z]?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid LanguageTool version format specified: $Version\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ -n \"$Version\" ]]; then File=\"LanguageTool-$Version.zip\"; else File=\"LanguageTool-stable.zip\"; fi; Url=\"https://languagetool.org/download/$File\"; Headers=$(wget -q -S --spider \"$Url\" 2>&1) || { echo \"Could not find $Url. Check the LanguageTool Version setting. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Marker=\"$File $(echo \"$Headers\" | grep -i -m1 'last-modified:' | cut -d: -f2- | tr -d '\r' | xargs) $(echo \"$Headers\" | grep -i -m1 'content-length:' | cut -d: -f2- | tr -d '\r' | xargs)\"; if [[ -f server/languagetool-server.jar && \"$(cat server/.installed-version 2>/dev/null)\" == \"$Marker\" ]]; then echo \"$File already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; rm -rf languagetool.zip extract; echo \"Downloading $Url\"; wget -qO languagetool.zip \"$Url\" || { rm -f languagetool.zip; echo \"Download failed from languagetool.org. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; mkdir -p extract; if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -q languagetool.zip -d extract; elif command -v bsdtar >/dev/null 2>&1; then bsdtar -xf languagetool.zip -C extract; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -I -m zipfile -e languagetool.zip extract; elif [[ -x java/bin/jar ]]; then (cd extract && ../java/bin/jar xf ../languagetool.zip); else echo \"No unzip tool found (unzip, bsdtar, python3 or a JDK). Aborting\"; exit 1; fi || { echo \"Extracting the archive failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Dir=$(find extract -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -n1); if [[ -z \"$Dir\" || ! -f \"$Dir/languagetool-server.jar\" ]]; then echo \"The downloaded archive does not contain languagetool-server.jar. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; rm -rf server && mv \"$Dir\" server && rm -rf extract languagetool.zip && echo \"$Marker\" > server/.installed-version && echo \"$(basename \"$Dir\") installed\""
